name: FullGrown
summary: A garden planner that finds plants for your exact conditions and shows how your beds will look in five years.

name: Random Point Generator
summary: Picks a truly random spot within any distance of a place you choose — a way to find somewhere to explore that you'd never have picked yourself.

name: Holiday Gap Finder
summary: Finds the three longest stretches of your year without a holiday, counting the ones you celebrate plus birthdays and family traditions, and the middle date of each: the best spots to add something new.
